Some coolers are steamers.

Some fans are steamers.

I. Some steamers are heaters.

II. All fans can be heaters.

From the given statements, the Venn diagram is:

I. Some steamers are heaters: Here, some steamers which are coolers are not heaters. Thus, the steamers which are not coolers can be heaters. So, conclusion I is false.

II. All fans can be heaters: Here, there is a possibility that some/all fans are heaters. So, conclusion II is true.

questions.q_en: 4th of October 2018 is a Thursday. What day would be 2nd of February 2019?
questions.solution_en:
4th of October 2018 is a Thursday.

October has 31 days so, 31 - 4 = 27

November has 30 days, December has 31 days and January has 31 days.

2 days of February.

Total = 27 + 30 +31+31 + 2 = 121

Now 121 when divided by 7, remainder will be 2.

So, day on 2nd of February 2019 would be Saturday.

questions.q_en:
A question is given followed by two statements (I) and (II). You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements is sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and select the appropriate answer.

Question: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing centre, but not necessarily in the same order. Four persons are sitting at corners and four on middle sides. A and F are sitting at the corners. H is not sitting at the corner. How many persons are sitting between A and H when counted in the clockwise direction from A?

Statements:

(I) C is to the second right of H. G is to the second right of A.

(II) D is facing H. A is facing B, who is to the immediate left of C.
options_en: Data in statement I and statement II together is not sufficient to answer the question
Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not
Data in statement I and statement II together is sufficient to answer the question
Data in either statement I alone or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question
questions.solution_en:
A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing centre, but not necessarily in the same order.

A and F are sitting at the corners. H is not sitting at the corner.

Statement I: C is to the second right of H. G is to the second right of A.

No definite arrangement can be established.

So, statement I alone is not sufficient.

Statement II: D is facing H. A is facing B, who is to the immediate left of C.

So, either none or four persons are sitting between A and H when counted in the clockwise direction from A.

So, statement II alone is not sufficient.

By combining I and II:

D is facing H. A is facing B, who is to the immediate left of C.

C is to the second right of H. G is to the second right of A.

F is sitting at the corner.

So, four persons are sitting between A and H when counted in the clockwise direction from A.

Thus, statements I and II together are sufficient.

questions.q_en: Aditi departs from her home and walks 38 m towards West and then turns right and walks 19 m. Now she turns right and walks 25 m. She then takes a left turn and walks 21 m. She then takes a left turn again and walks 38 m. She takes a final left turn and walks 25 m to stop at point X. How far is she from a pole which is 15 m North of her house? (Assume that all turns are 90 degree turns only.)
questions.solution_en:
Aditi departs from her home and walks 38 m towards West

Then turns right and walks 19 m.

Now she turns right and walks 25 m.

She then takes a left turn and walks 21 m.

She then takes a left turn again and walks 38 m.

She takes a final left turn and walks 25 m to stop at point X

And Pole is 15 m north of her house

So distance between Pole and X is 38 m + (38 - 25)m = 38 + 13 = 51 m.

Option (c) is the correct answer.

II. Serious

III. Serein

IV. Serial

145 ≠ 65

Thus, option (b) is incorrect.

150 + 15 - 100 = 65

165 - 100 = 65

65 = 65

LHS is equal to RHS.

Thus, option (c) is correct.

545 ≠ 65
